If you want to say Happy New Year everyone... then at least post by the first half of January! It's a wizard!

Yes. That's why we've kept you waiting for so long.
It's the beginning of the year, and I've been saying things like, let's draw a picture related to the zodiac, and the month is already over. It's like what you're doing.
Furthermore, I don't really understand the policy of doing a sequel to a painting that was about two years ago, but there's no particular reason for it, it's just a whim.

Click here for the previous work
https://magicshop.fanbox.cc/posts/7212150

So, as you can see, the story is about a horse king who gets infected with the poisonous fangs of a bad rabbit and rapes his daughter.
Why are these baby tentacles growing? Or what is fusion? If you're interested in stories like this, please check out the previous work.

At the end of the previous film, there was a story about what happened to the Umanami tribe, but what happened after that was... In the end, it seems that the Go King Sama was caught up in the murderous plot of the vile Usa queen and was completely fused together.
However, even if we were to depict the story around that point, it would only play out in much the same way as the previous work, so this time we had Princess Ugo, the daughter of King Ugo, appear and do all sorts of things as she pleases, such as doing all sorts of things with her horse Ichimotsu, turning into a futanari and making horse chins.
Well... I guess she's actually a more dignified princess, but as a trait of the Umanami tribe, she couldn't resist a strong male and was instantly defeated.

And, well... that's what the work is like.
Activities have been slow since last year, and as a magician, I feel very sorry for him. As expected of me this year, I have a desire to get a little more active, so if you don't mind, I hope you'll come and see it if you feel like it.

See you next time!
